_comment: Generic mid-season FPL account-migration configuration. This does NOT represent one person leaving and a different person joining — it represents the SAME person ('person') switching to a new FPL entry id mid-season (e.g. their old account became unavailable/was lost). From GW1 up to (effective_gw - 1) the OLD entry id is used when fetching/recording FPL data for this person's slot. From effective_gw onward, the id already stored in league.json (== new_entry_id) is used as-is. Any transfer cost caused by squad differences between the old and new accounts is applied ONCE, only on effective_gw, directly into that GW's team points used for standings. The person's identity/name never changes across the swap — only the underlying FPL entry id does.
